pivHint: ROCK isn't just David's refuge. In the childhood hand game, it's one of three moves — and this one beats it by covering it.
winText: You found it. ROCK isn't just David's refuge — it's also one of three moves in ROCK-PAPER-Scissors, and PAPER is the move that beats it.
lossText: The word was PAPER. ROCK was the pivot — in the hand game ROCK-PAPER-Scissors, PAPER beats ROCK by covering it.
votdVerse: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
passageText: I love you, Lord, my strength. The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold. I called to the Lord, who is worthy of praise, and I have been saved from my enemies. The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me. The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
